description: PA derives both recursion equations for the chosen normalized recursion graph with the chosen normalized base and step graphs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program.sigmaGraph_recursion_equations {n : ℕ}
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program n)
  (g : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program (n + 2)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.allClose
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.recursionZeroFormula (f.prec g).sigmaGraph f.sigmaGraph)) ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.allClose
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.recursionSuccessorFormula (f.prec g).sigmaGraph g.sigmaGraph))
